name: Just Sign Here!
source:
After coming into your room, you find yourself greeted by a strange man who wants you to sign this 'business' contract. Should you blindly sign this paper? Or be a bit more cautious of this man?

[From [url=https://vincent-classic.itch.io/just-sign-here]itch.io[/url]]
